title: Independent reconstruction and priority audit of the Gram bound
objective: Independently reconstruct the defect-determinant proof and the n=2/high-sigma C001 corollaries, then separate the classical Meany result from any harness-specific deduction by a primary-source priority audit.
acceptance_checks: The proof is organized independently of the original derivation.
Every external inequality is tied to a primary source and exact theorem statement.
The similarity and norm arguments remain in their correct coordinate spaces.
The high-sigma corollary is checked for novelty before any promotion.
